title: Does Music Make You Study Better?
subject: Science fair
blurb: A science fair poster says music makes you smarter. Look at how the test was set up.
intro: This poster won second place at the school science fair.
body: MUSIC MAKES YOU SMARTER! My question was: does listening to music help you study? Here is what I did. I studied my spelling words for 20 minutes while listening to my favorite songs. Then I took the spelling test on Friday and got 18 out of 20. Last month I studied without music and got 14 out of 20. That is 4 more words right with music. So music makes your brain work better. Everyone should listen to music while they study.

chart.alt: A simple bar graph comparing one test with music to one test without music, with notes showing the two tests had different words and different study times.

transcript.text: Student: I love music, so I thought it would help me study.
Student: The words last month were way harder than this week's words.
Student: I only tested myself, nobody else.

opening_prompt: This poster says music makes you smarter. What would you need to know before you believe it? You can highlight a sentence or click part of the graph.
